name: Poisoned Blade
subtitle: looks good enough to eat
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- If the attached character inflicts damage to a character, destroy the damaged character. -- HANDOFF -- COST – Deplete a character you control that is not in a battle. -- EFFECT – Attach this card to the character.
flavor: "Would you mind dipping those apples as well?"
notes: Card prints 'If the attached character...'; catalog uses 'When'. No artist credit in footer.

name: Recreant Cad
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Silvia Gunarso
rules: SNEAK -- COST – Use this only if your opponent has at least 10 cards in their discard pile. Pay 1. Remove 2 cards in your opponent's discard pile from the game. -- EFFECT – This turn, this card gains COVERT.
notes: Card says 'your opponent' / 'your opponent's discard pile'; catalog says 'an opponent' / 'that player's discard pile' (updated templating). Artist credited only in the subtitle (Silvia Gunarso); no Art: line in footer.

name: Throatstabber
subtitle: oh, i'm sorry...were you saying something?
rules: When this card enters play, flip a coin. If you lose, deplete this card.

name: Two-Headed Coin
subtitle: limited edition artwork by FangWei
rules: If you lose a coin flip, you may shuffle this card into your deck. If you do, reflip that coin and draw a card instead.
flavor: "78 in a row. A new record, I imagine."
notes: Card: 'shuffle this card into your deck... reflip that coin and draw a card instead'; catalog: 'into its owner's deck... reflip that coin and use that result instead and draw a card' (clarified templating, same play). Artist credited only in subtitle (FangWei).

name: Unexpected Boobysnake
subtitle: nobody expects the unexpected boobysnake!
rules: You may play this card whenever you could play a tactic. If you do, discard a card or destroy this card.
notes: Card: discard-or-destroy penalty applies whenever you play it using the tactic-timing permission ('If you do'). Catalog: TACTICAL keyword + 'if you deployed it during an opponent's turn' condition and 'When this card enters play' trigger; the opponent's-turn restriction is not printed.

name: Wild Boars
subtitle: freshly summoned from the abyss
rules: While this card is the only member of an attacking party, only characters with at least X speed can block it, where X is this card's speed.
flavor: "We should have ordered the chicken!"

name: Anxious Oaf
subtitle: BUH-NEE!
rules: When an attacking or blocking party is formed that includes this card, it must have at least 2 members.
flavor: "Castle Direstock? Most people never even make it past the rabbits."
notes: Card: 'formed that includes this card'; catalog: 'formed including this card'.

name: Assimilation Center
subtitle: these are lost drunken men who don't care
rules: "RECRUIT" -- COST – Pay 1. Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – Search your deck for a character, reveal it, and put it on the top of your deck.
flavor: "And these are lost drunken men who do care! And these are men who aren't lost and care, but don't drink."
notes: Card: 'Search your deck for a character, reveal it, and put it on the top of your deck.'; catalog splits into two sentences (same play).

name: Barbaric Rifleman
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Zi Jian
rules: When this card enters play, inflict 1 damage to your opponent's faction.
flavor: Zi Jian's tears can cure cancer. Too bad he's never cried.
notes: Card: 'your opponent's faction'; catalog: 'an opponent's faction'. Artist credited only in subtitle (Zi Jian).

name: Battle Surge
subtitle: unleash the killer in you
rules: This turn, all your characters gain 1 strength.
flavor: Its smell alone can drive sane men into a murderous frenzy.

name: Blow Up
subtitle: i make boom
rules: COST – Pick an item. -- EFFECT – Destroy the item. Your opponent's faction loses 3 influence.
notes: Card: 'Your opponent's faction loses 3 influence.' Catalog: 'That item's controller's faction loses 3 influence.' (differs when the picked item is yours / controlled by someone else).

name: Brash Basher
subtitle: he's in over your head
flavor: "...we're going to Clockman, and Blightmore, and Marmothoa, and then we're going to go to Castle Direstock and we're gonna take back the YYYEEEEEAAAAAAARRRRRGGGGGHHHH!!!!"
notes: No rules text on card or in catalog. The word 'your' in the subtitle is italic/underlined. Letter counts in the final 'YYYEEE...' shout are estimated.

name: Callow Liegeman
subtitle: hazing? do your worst.
rules: If this card attacks in a party with more than 1 member, it gains 1 strength and 1 life this turn.
flavor: You know if you stab a man in the dead of winter, steam will rise up from the wounds.
notes: Card: 'If this card attacks...'; catalog: 'When this card attacks...'.

name: Deadly Striker
subtitle: rock you like a hurricane
rules: If this card is destroyed, your opponent's faction loses 4 influence.
flavor:
Dear Sir or Madam:
The Imperial Army regrets to inform you that your son(s) are dead because they got blowed up. Sorry for the inconvenience.
Best wishes,
Praxis, Grand General of Bad Death Stuff
notes: Card: 'If this card is destroyed, your opponent's faction'; catalog: 'When... an opponent's faction'.

name: Dethmürderblüdgeon, the Craghammer
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Patrick Meehan
rules: UNIQUE DETHMÜRDERBLÜDGEON -- ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- The attached character gains 2 strength and 2 life. -- If the attached character is blocked, your opponent's faction loses 2 influence. -- If the attached character inflicts damage to a faction, you may pick a character. If you do, inflict 2 damage to that character. -- If this card would go to your discard pile from play, put it into your hand instead.
notes: Card: 'If the attached character is blocked, your opponent's faction'; 'would go to your discard pile from play, put it into your hand'. Catalog: 'When...blocked, an opponent's faction'; 'put into a discard pile from play, put it into its owner's hand'. Badges +2 STR, +0 SPD, +2 LIFE. Artist credited only in subtitle (Patrick Meehan).

name: Distraction
subtitle: ohh noes!!!!1
rules: COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Deplete the character.
flavor: "I keep an extra severed head handy for just such an occasion..."

name: Elbow Dropper
subtitle: i can't believe it! that's gotta hurt!
rules: OFF THE TOP ROPE -- COST – Deplete this card. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character cannot block.
flavor: "Illegal, Mean Jean!"

name: Explosive Fury
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Patrick Meehan
rules: COST – Pick a character you control. X is that character's strength. Destroy that character. Pick another character. -- EFFECT – Inflict X damage to the other character.
flavor: We really wish Patrick Meehan would wear pants in the office. Any pants. We've tried asking him nicely, but he won't listen. And frankly, we're tired of getting poked in the eye.
notes: Catalog says 'Destroy it' / 'the character'; card says 'Destroy that character' / 'the other character'. Same play. Artist credited only in subtitle (Patrick Meehan).

name: Fleshripping Scenepuller
subtitle: his face? i didn't like it.
rules: If this card is blocked, it gains 4 strength for each member in the opposing party.
flavor: He'll beat you to death, eat your flesh, and sew your skin into his clothing. And if you're very, very lucky, he'll do it in that order.
notes: Card has no duration ('it gains 4 strength for each member in the opposing party'); catalog adds 'this turn it gains...'. Duration differs.

name: Gore Engine
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Ivan Ng
rules: If a character is destroyed during a turn when this card damaged it, put X tokens on this card, where X is the strength of that character. -- This card gains 1 strength for each token on it. -- IMPALE -- COST – Pay 2 or remove 2 tokens from this card. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character must block this card if it can.
notes: Card: 'If a character is destroyed...'; catalog: 'When a character is destroyed...'. Artist credited only in subtitle (Ivan Ng).

name: Infuriator
subtitle: strong words from a strong man
rules: When this card enters play, all your characters gain 1 strength this turn.
flavor: "...and your big ugly face is as dumb as a butt!"

name: Lieutenant General
subtitle: it is good to be loved. it is better to be feared.
rules: If an attacking party is formed including this character, all other "soldier" characters in that party gain 1 life this turn.
flavor: "There is no avoiding war; it can only be postponed to the advantage of others."
notes: Card: 'If an attacking party is formed...'; catalog: 'When...'.

name: Morale Officer
subtitle: brings out the best in his men
rules: CONVINCE -- COST – Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – This turn, all your "soldier" characters gain 1 strength.
flavor: "And when we're done, I have no doubt you'll embrace the good and truth of our cause."

name: Murderous Commander
subtitle: next!
rules: CUNNING PLAN -- COST – Pay 2. Discard a card. Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – Inflict 2 damage to your opponent's faction.
flavor: "You see killmajigs have a preset kill limit. Knowing their weakness, I sent wave after wave of my own men at them...until they reached their limit and shut down."
notes: Card: 'your opponent's faction'; catalog: 'an opponent's faction'.

name: Needless Beating
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Silvia Gunarso
rules: COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Inflict 2 damage to the character. If your opponent's faction has 15 influence or less, inflict 1 additional damage to the character. If your opponent's faction has 10 influence or less, inflict 1 damage to each character your opponent controls. If your opponent's faction has 5 influence or less, draw a card.
notes: Card: cost is just 'Pick a character' (any character) and the thresholds check 'your opponent's faction'. Catalog: 'EXTRA COST: Pick an opponent. Pick a character that player controls' and thresholds check 'that player's faction'. Targeting and which faction is checked differ. Artist credited only in subtitle (Silvia Gunarso).

name: Penetrate
subtitle: sometimes a ram is just a ram
rules: COST – Pick an attacking character you control. -- EFFECT – If the character would assign battle damage to the blocking party during this battle, assign that damage to the faction or location being attacked instead.
notes: Card: 'assign that damage to the faction or location being attacked'; catalog: 'assign it to the target of the attack'.

name: Pinch
subtitle: i peench
rules: COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Inflict 1 damage to the character.
flavor: Maybe just a little peench?

name: Really Big Barduse
subtitle: i didn't know you played the ass-trombone!
rules: COST – You may pick 2 or fewer characters. -- When this card enters play, if you picked characters as part of its cost then inflict up to 5 damage divided however you want to the characters. -- (If you didn't pay this card's cost then you cannot inflict damage.)
flavor: "It's not the random devouring that bothers me. It's the way he plays with them first."
notes: Card has an extra italic reminder paragraph '(If you didn't pay this card's cost then you cannot inflict damage.)' not in catalog; catalog says 'those characters'.

name: Ruthless Platoon
subtitle: Bob was tasty for a thin guy
rules: CANNIBALIZE -- COST – Destroy a character you control. -- EFFECT – This turn, this card gains 2 strength.
flavor: "You know most people overlook it, but there's a lot of good meat on the face."

name: Sadistic Colonel
subtitle: eeny, meeny, miney, moe
rules: If your opponent plays a tactic, inflict 2 damage to their faction.
flavor: Colonel Blastwad always makes inspection a lot of fun!
notes: Card: 'If your opponent plays a tactic'; catalog: 'When an opponent deploys a tactic'.

name: Skin Suit
subtitle: wear it while it's wet
rules: COST – Pick a character you control. X is that character's strength. Pick a character your opponent controls. Y is that character's strength. -- EFFECT – Inflict X damage to your opponent's character. Inflict Y damage to your character. If only 1 of the characters is destroyed by this damage, remove it from the game instead. For the rest of the game, the surviving character has all rules text of the removed character in addition to its own rules text.
notes: Card has 'For the rest of the game, the surviving character has all rules text of the removed character in addition to its own rules text.'; catalog has 'The surviving character gains all rules text of the removed character.' (no explicit duration) and adds 'simultaneously' to the two damage steps, which the card does not say.

name: Splattergun
subtitle: the room looks better in red
rules: UNLOAD -- COST – Deplete this card. Pick a character or faction. -- EFFECT – Inflict 3 damage to the character or faction. Your opponent takes control of this card.
notes: Card: 'Your opponent takes control of this card.' Catalog: 'That faction's or character's controller takes control of this card.' (differs when the target is yours). Item has no subtype printed.

name: Suicide Squad
subtitle: perhaps today is a good day to die!
rules: ULTIMATE SACRIFICE -- COST – X is this card's strength. Destroy this card. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Inflict X damage to the character.
flavor: "...prepare for RAMMING SPEED!"

name: Swordchucks
subtitle: i know you're angry, but don't lose your head
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- The attached character gains 4 strength. -- If any amount of damage is inflicted to the attached character, increase the amount by 2. -- HANDOFF -- COST – Pay 3. Deplete a character you control that is not in a battle. -- EFFECT – Attach this card to the character.
notes: Card: 'If any amount of damage is inflicted to the attached character'; catalog: 'When damage is inflicted to the attached character'. Badges +4 STR, +0 SPD, +0 LIFE.

name: Thundering Nilpha
subtitle: crushing coils of carnage
rules: While this card is the only member of an attacking party that is attacking a location, it gains 1 strength and cannot be blocked.
flavor:
Smashed into pulp, dashed to bloody ribbons on the rocks, spined and impaled, devoured and ingested, boiled alive in the churning belly of the demon.
Good times.
notes: Card requires this card to be the ONLY member of an attacking party attacking a location; catalog says only 'While this card is attacking a location' (missing the only-member condition).

name: Torrential Bleeder
subtitle: let the death shower begin!
rules: At the start of your turn, inflict 1 damage to all characters.
flavor: "Damn you bleedy buggers! Damn you to hell!"

name: Trip Wire
subtitle: always good for a chuckle
rules: COST – Play this only while you are being attacked. -- EFFECT – Inflict up to 3 damage divided however you want to the attacking characters.
notes: Card: 'Play this only while you are being attacked'; catalog: 'Deploy this only...' (updated templating).

name: Trophy Collector
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Zi Jian
rules: COST – Play this only if your opponent's faction has 10 influence or less.
flavor: We always wondered about those veiny, dried up hot dogs Zi Jian brings for lunch.
notes: Card: 'Play this only if your opponent's faction'; catalog: 'Deploy this only if an opponent's faction'. Artist credited only in subtitle (Zi Jian).

name: Wyrmfang Deathskull
subtitle: who lives in a pineapple under the sea?
rules: UNIQUE WYRMFANG -- If you attack, your opponent must pick any number of characters they control. Those characters must block during this battle if they can, and only those characters can block.
flavor: WYRM-FANG-DEATH-SKULL!
notes: Card: 'If you attack, your opponent must pick...'; catalog: 'When you attack, the controller of the faction or location you are attacking picks...' (same in 1v1). Flavor 'WYRM-FANG-' is bold italic, 'DEATH-SKULL!' larger.
